        c += matrix[rt[-1]][depot]

        to_rt = routes[j]
        ld_to = route_load(to_rt) + demands[v]
        if ld_to > capacity:
            return None

        best = None
        # try all insertion positions including ends
        if not to_rt:

            new_to = [v]

            best = ("relocate", i, j, pos, 0, new_cost - base)
            return best

        base_cost = route_cost(from_rt) + route_cost(to_rt)
        for ins in range(len(to_rt) + 1):
            new_to = to_rt[:ins] + [v] + to_rt[ins:]
